messages.author: 4e5f68e42ed78701
messages.subject: Point count
parts:
Greeting,

I am trying to figure out how get the density of each bird specie from my
fix radius count point (forest). I scattered randomly 70 point in 2-forest
cover (more or less 50/50). I filled the data sheet but only I got models
for all bird no separate as species. It is possible realize this kind of
process?
Thanks in advance,


Jorge Valenzuela
Centro de Estudios y Conservaci=F3n
del Patrimonio Natural
X regi=F3n
Chile

messages.author: 12f269733c6eb9a2
messages.subject: Re: Point count
parts:
Jorge:

I believe what you want to do is possible, however, you will need to=20
provide more information regarding the way in which you set up your=20
Distance project.=20

Examine the "songbird.dst" project that is in the example projects=20
folder, and that came with your installation of Distance. That is a set=20
of point transect data for songbirds (corresponding to section 8.7 of=20
the Introduction to Distance Sampling book by Buckland et al. (2001). =20
Work through that project and see if that provides inspiration for your=20
dilemmas. If you are still having difficulties, send more questions to=20
the list.
